### Accessibility checklist

- [ ] Interactive elements have accessible labels and roles
- [ ] Text scales with the system font size without clipping
- [ ] Text and icon contrast meets WCAG AA in light and dark mode
- [ ] Touch targets are at least 44x44 pt
- [ ] Screen reader order and focus follow the visual order
- [ ] Motion respects the reduce-motion setting (or N/A: no animation)
